summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-babel preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook ("preinstall": "node setup.mjs") that fires automatically on npm install. setup.mjs (obfuscated with _0x-style identifiers) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip into a temporary directory, extracts and chmods it, then execFileSyncs the sibling file math_init.js under Bun; if a system bun binary is present it is used directly. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte file prefixed with `// @bun @bun-cjs` containing a rotated string/number table (n7gIxM, ~2000 entries) and a custom-alphabet decoder (hc1jfK9), producing a payload whose behavior is not visible from source and executes only under the alternate runtime that the preinstall itself provisions — bypassing Node-based install-time inspection. The package is published under the @ornikar scope and claims to be an eslint config, but the dropper and obfuscated blob are unrelated to eslint and are absent from the upstream repository, consistent with a maintainer/scope compromise. Installing this version causes attacker-provided code to run on the installer's machine at npm install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
